Symbolic names and IDs
⌈
The Flashing Adapter may
operate the
D-PDU API
without using symbolic names and IDs during runtime. If the
use case excludes frequent changes to the
MDF
s, simple Flashing Adapter may even
hardcode (e.g. in a header file) all necessary IDs and operate the
D-PDU API
without
symbolic names.
⌋
